goal: Review scoped, read-only cross-event original-source retrieval and its assessment/pool gate; no autonomous alternative rewriting.
protected_expectations: Existing semantic labels, source data, graph, approval/hit gates and prior episodes
Original claim, role requirements, citations, no fabricated sources or metadata-only proof
No matches is not contradiction; incomplete search cannot approve; no hidden failure-to-deferral repair credit
review_scope: Read target diff against a25b899 and controller diff against be125af; existing earlier review is not certification of these changes.
Review actual source/diff, supplied test logs/code bindings and bounded local-model pilot including failures. Inspect new sections of bilingual docs and master status.

Check only supplied entity snapshot/manifest is searched; originals resolved through existing resolver, exact facets/as-of constraints, namespace/source hash/quote preservation and linkage checks; related sources never add pool hits.
Review no silent source truncation, future/missing-time behavior, corpus limits and unavailable/oversize originals. Distinguish deterministic gating tests and same-model semantic quality.
Controller may add frozen extra fixture files; reject missing/duplicate coverage and preserve old cases/episodes.

Read-only: no source changes, agents, publication, merge, provider choices, budget renewals or test reruns requiring writes. Review ordinary actionable corrections without inventing new permission requirements.
mandatory_evidence: Frozen source-context positive/negative cases, previous labels preserved
Source-aware review UI source/syntax inspection; no unperformed browser claim
